description: Extract every string value from a document. Parses JSON, YAML, CSV, TOML, INI and dotenv; for any other format it falls back to quoted strings — single, double or backtick — so a format is optional but unquoted prose yields nothing. Returns the values themselves, in document order, not their positions.

dedupe.description: Collapse repeated values to their first occurrence.

filename.description: Filename used to infer the format when `format` is absent, e.g. "config.toml".

format.description: Document format. Optional — an unrecognised or absent format falls back to extracting quoted strings.

maxResults.description: Cap on returned strings (default 500). meta.truncated reports whether any were dropped.

multiline.description: For a format nothing here parses, let a quoted run span lines, so a multi-line template literal or message is read too. Languages whose own strings span lines are read that way regardless.

name: extract_strings
